sweet_potato.notes: Grown from slips (rooted sprouts) rather than seed; indoor start here means sprouting slips from a stored root. Needs warm soil and a long season. Too much nitrogen gives leaves instead of roots. Cure the roots somewhere warm for a week or two before storing.
